meta.title: Mestechko: online booking in Telegram
meta.description: Online booking for salons, barbershops, clinics and auto services: a Telegram Mini App, a bot with reminders and a dashboard with the schedule.

hero.title: Got a spot?
hero.lead: Clients book in a minute, the bot reminds them of the visit, and you see everything in one schedule.
hero.note: The demo runs on fictional data, so click anything
hero.visual: The dashboard with the schedule and the client Mini App

demoChoice.title: What would you like to open?
demoChoice.cabinetText: Schedule, clients, reports: sign in as the owner or a specialist
demoChoice.miniappText: Book a visit at a demo beauty studio

book.title: The client picks a spot
book.text: Service, specialist and an open time, in a Mini App right inside Telegram.

schedule.title: Straight into the schedule
schedule.text: Drag a visit and the client is notified automatically.

remind.title: The bot sends reminders
remind.text: A day and two hours before. Confirming, rescheduling and cancelling take one tap.

prepay.title: Deposits
prepay.text: The time is held while the client pays.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.text: When a time opens up, the first person in line gets it.

noDouble.title: No double bookings
noDouble.text: One time, one booking, even when two people tap at once.

surfaces.title: Your whole business in one place

cabinet.title: Dashboard
cabinet.text: Team and schedules, services and prices, clients, packages and reports.

widget.title: Website widget
widget.text: One line of code, and clients book right on your website.

points.embed: Inline on the page or as a button with a pop-up
points.isolation: The website's styles and the widget's never mix

max.title: Telegram bot
max.text: One bot for every business: reminders, rescheduling and the waitlist.

verticals.title: Who it's for
verticals.lead: Salons, barbershops, clinics and auto services each get their own words, services and rules.
